reserves.name: Apollo Diversified Credit Fund NAV
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Apollo Diversified Credit Fund (Apollo Global Management; tokenized and administered by Securitize)

reserveReview.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-8 (lead rwausdi-multipli)
reserveReview.rationale: ACRED is an ERC-4626 feeder share into the Apollo Diversified Credit Fund, so the fund NAV — tracked live by the Chainlink ACRED NAV oracle that backs the configured reserve adapter — is the reserve asset. Securitize describes the fund as multi-strategy private credit (direct lending, structured credit, performing credit, and dislocated credit) without dated public position weights, so the NAV is retained as one classified fund-share slice with the internal allocation recorded as the known unknown.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Chainlink ACRED NAV oracle (the configured live-reserve surface) and Securitize fund disclosures
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The fund's current allocation across its credit strategies, positions, maturities, and cash is not published as dated weights; only strategy-level descriptions are public.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The fund publishes strategy-level descriptions of its diversified credit book but no dated constituent weights.

providers.name: Apollo Diversified Credit Fund (underlying fund vehicle; custodian undisclosed in reviewed sources)
Securitize (tokenization, fund administration and transfer agent)

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-8 (lead rwausdi-multipli)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: ACRED represents a share of the Apollo Diversified Credit Fund, a regulated investment vehicle whose assets are held at the fund level apart from Securitize's tokenization stack, supporting structural bankruptcy remoteness; the fund's custodian, segregation terms, and any leverage or reuse are not disclosed in the reviewed public sources.
